title: OpenAI pilots OpenWorks, free in-person AI help for independently owned U.S. small businesses
summary: OpenAI started a pilot called OpenWorks on November 23, 2026 that pays local partners to help independently owned U.S. small businesses put AI to work, at no cost to the owner. Participating businesses also get three months of ChatGPT Business. Software and SaaS firms, venture-backed companies and private-equity-owned businesses are excluded; nonprofits and faith-based groups may apply. Partners are contractors who receive a stipend of up to $8,000 a month and must spend at least four days a month working in person with local businesses. The pilot starts in a limited set of U.S. communities, and owners elsewhere can register interest. OpenAI's help page does not say what happens after the free three months.
why: Free setup help lowers the cost of trying AI, but plan for what the tools will cost once the three-month trial ends.
